title: 人机工效与工位设置
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/147_人机工效与工位设置.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/147_人机工效与工位设置/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在一把可调实验椅上，拍拍椅背
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits on an adjustable laboratory chair and pats the backrest, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第13章第一课：人机工效与工位设置。

shots.scene: 欣欣转动椅子的升降手柄
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pulls the height lever under the chair and the seat rises a little.
shots.narration: 让工位适应你，别让你迁就工位。

shots.scene: 小研在显微镜前看了一下午
shots.prompt_en: In a university laboratory in the afternoon, the female graduate student looks into a microscope for a long time.
shots.narration: 小研对着显微镜，看了一下午。

shots.scene: 椅子太低，她探着头、耸着肩
shots.prompt_en: Side view: the chair is too low, the female graduate student stretches her neck forward and raises her shoulders to reach the eyepieces.
shots.narration: 椅子太低，她一直探头耸肩。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在矮实验台前弯腰配溶液
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a low laboratory bench, bending his back deeply to prepare solutions.
shots.narration: 阿杰在矮台前，弯着腰配溶液。

shots.scene: 两人揉着脖子和腰，王老师走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rubs her neck and the young male student rubs his lower back as the safety administrator walks over.
shots.narration: 王老师：工位没调好，身体在报警。

shots.scene: 人与工位、仪器、工具连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in the center linked to four icons, a task list, a workbench, an instrument and a hand tool. No text.
shots.narration: 人机工效：让工作适应人的身体。

shots.scene: 移液、看镜、记录、搬运四个场景
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four small scenes, pipetting, looking into a microscope, typing on a computer and carrying a box. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室任务多，身体负担各不同。

shots.scene: 小负担一天天累积成酸痛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small weight icons piling up day after day on a calendar until a back pain icon appears. No text.
shots.narration: 小负担天天累积，就成了劳损。

shots.scene: 高个子和矮个子站在同一实验台前
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tall student and a short student at the same bench, one stooping and one reaching up. No text.
shots.narration: 高矮胖瘦不同，需求也不同。

shots.scene: 小研和老周一起调整工位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man adjust her chair and bench layout together.
shots.narration: 按自己调工位，和导师一起商量。

shots.scene: 五个原因图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five icons in a column, an overstretched arm, a looping arrow, a twisted body, a heavy weight and a wrong tool. No text.
shots.narration: 劳损的常见原因有五个。

shots.scene: 伸手够远处、弯腰扭身
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure reaching far across a bench and another twisting while bending, both with warning icons. No text.
shots.narration: 伸得太远、弯腰扭身，是别扭姿势。

shots.scene: 用力按压、重复箭头、时钟叠加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pressing hard, a repeat arrow and a long clock stacked together, the risk bar rising. No text.
shots.narration: 用力大、次数多、时间长，风险叠加。

shots.scene: 风险评估表里加上工效一栏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank risk assessment sheet with a new row marked by a posture icon being ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 做风险评估，别漏了工效风险。

shots.scene: 关节处于自然位置的人形图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a relaxed human figure with joints in natural neutral positions, green dots on wrist, elbow, shoulder and neck. No text.
shots.narration: 关节最省力的位置，叫中立姿势。

shots.scene: 【实拍】手腕伸直，像要和人握手（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand held straight in line with the forearm as if ready for a handshake.
shots.narration: 手腕伸直，像要和人握手。

shots.scene: 手腕弯曲上翘，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrist bent sharply up and down with a red stress mark, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手腕弯着翘着，压力大得多。

shots.scene: 【实拍】上臂贴身，前臂约成直角（侧面中景）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: a person at a bench with upper arms relaxed at the sides and forearms bent at about a right angle.
shots.narration: 上臂贴身，前臂约成直角。

shots.scene: 小研伸展手臂和肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stretches her arms and rolls her shoulders beside the bench.
shots.narration: 常做拉伸，缓解肌肉紧张。

shots.scene: 台面高度和手肘高度对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person at a bench with a dashed line showing elbow height level with the work surface. No text.
shots.narration: 台面高度，是中立姿势的关键。

shots.scene: 台面太矮弯腰、太高耸肩，两图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: left, a bench too low with a bent back; right, a bench too high with raised shoulders; both with warning icons. No text.
shots.narration: 台面太矮累腰，太高累肩。

shots.scene: 【实拍】坐下后用升降手柄调椅子，手肘与台面齐平
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand pulls the chair height lever, the seated person rises until the elbows are level with the bench top.
shots.narration: 坐着就调椅子，让手肘与台面齐平。

shots.scene: 个子矮的同学站在稳固的踏台上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short student standing on a wide stable platform at a high bench, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 站着够不着，垫个稳固的平台。

shots.scene: 设备跟着人调，人不歪着迁就
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from a person to an adjustable bench and chair, and a crossed out person bending to fit a fixed bench. No text.
shots.narration: 按人调设备，别让人迁就设备。

shots.scene: 常用物品摆在正前方伸手可及的区域
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: top view of a bench with frequently used items inside a small arc right in front of the person. No text.
shots.narration: 常用物品，放在身体正前方。

shots.scene: 一手撑台、一手够远处，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person leaning on one hand and reaching far with the other, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别一手撑台，一手去够远处。

shots.scene: 人挤在角落扭身操作，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person squeezed into a bench corner twisting the body, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 少扭身，别把自己挤在角落。

shots.scene: 仪器常用按钮在手边
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an instrument control panel placed at elbow height within easy reach, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 常用按钮和工具，放在顺手处。

shots.scene: 坐着的人形图，腰部亮红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a seated figure with the lower back highlighted in red. No text.
shots.narration: 坐着，其实也很累腰。

shots.scene: 【实拍】坐正，椅背托住腰部，双脚平放地面（侧面中景）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: a person sitting upright with the lower back supported by the chair backrest and both feet flat on the floor.
shots.narration: 椅背托住腰，双脚平放地面。

shots.scene: 腰后垫毛巾卷，脚下加脚踏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rolled towel placed behind the lower back and a footrest under the feet of a seated person. No text.
shots.narration: 腰托不够加靠垫，脚悬空就加脚踏。

shots.scene: 坐实验凳：臀部前移，脚踩横撑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person on a backless lab stool sitting slightly forward with feet resting on the stool crossbar. No text.
shots.narration: 实验凳没靠背，往前坐、脚踩横撑。

shots.scene: 背颈弯曲扭转，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure with a hunched back and twisted neck, crossed out, beside an upright figure with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 背和颈最易伤，别乱弯乱扭。

shots.scene: 久站的人腿和腰发红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a standing figure at a bench with legs and lower back highlighted in red and a clock. No text.
shots.narration: 久站，腰腿也会酸痛。

shots.scene: 阿杰一只脚踩在搁脚台上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the bench with one foot resting on a low footrest, then switches feet.
shots.narration: 两脚轮流受力，踩个搁脚台。

shots.scene: 脚下铺防疲劳垫，穿包头舒适鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an anti-fatigue mat on the floor and closed-toe comfortable lab shoes, both with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 铺防疲劳垫，穿舒适的包头鞋。

shots.scene: 能坐的步骤坐高脚实验椅
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits on a tall lab chair with a footring to do a seated step at a high bench.
shots.narration: 能坐着做的步骤，就坐下来做。

shots.scene: 看显微镜，脖子肩膀发红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure at a microscope with the neck and shoulders highlighted in red. No text.
shots.narration: 看显微镜，脖子肩膀最累。

shots.scene: 【实拍】调好椅子和目镜，坐直看显微镜（侧面中景）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: a person sitting upright at a microscope, eyepieces adjusted to eye level, back straight, forearms resting on the bench.
shots.narration: 调好椅子和目镜，坐直别探头。

shots.scene: 双手搬显微镜：一手握臂，一手托座
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two hands carrying a microscope, one holding the arm and one supporting the base. No text.
shots.narration: 搬显微镜，一手握臂一手托座。

shots.scene: 通风柜前：头留在柜外，物品放顺手处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person seated at a fume hood with the head outside the sash and items placed within easy reach. No text.
shots.narration: 通风柜前，头留在柜外别探进去。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜前：调椅高，前臂平放，脚踩脚踏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person seated at a biological safety cabinet with the chair raised, forearms level and feet on a footrest. No text.
shots.narration: 安全柜前，调高座椅，脚下放脚踏。

shots.scene: 手套箱：手套口与肩平齐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person seated at a glove box with the glove ports level with the shoulders. No text.
shots.narration: 手套箱：调座椅，让手套口与肩平。

shots.scene: 分段操作，抽手休息
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock with a pause icon and arms withdrawn from a cabinet to rest. No text.
shots.narration: 柜里久操作，分段做、定时歇。

shots.scene: 老李仰头举臂修吊顶上的管线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands with arms raised overhead, tilting his head back to work on a ceiling pipe.
shots.narration: 长时间仰头举臂，颈肩易劳损。

shots.scene: 升高平台，活儿在胸前；两人轮换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a raised stable platform bringing the work to chest height, two workers taking turns. No text.
shots.narration: 调高平台让活儿在胸前，轮换着做。

shots.scene: 老李跪在护膝垫上修柜下水管，带头灯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer kneels on a knee pad under a sink cabinet with a work light and a long-handled tool.
shots.narration: 钻柜下修理，垫护膝、带照明。

shots.scene: 零件拆下拿到台面上修
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a part removed from under a cabinet and placed on a bench for repair, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 能拆下来的，拿到台面上修。

shots.scene: 看电脑的人颈腕发红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure at a computer with the neck and wrists highlighted in red. No text.
shots.narration: 整天看电脑，颈和手腕易劳损。

shots.scene: 【实拍】显示器上沿与视线平齐，约一臂远（侧面中景）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: a seated person with the top edge of a blank monitor at eye level and about an arm's length away.
shots.narration: 屏幕上沿与视线平齐，约一臂远。

shots.scene: 键盘鼠标放近，手腕平直
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a keyboard and mouse placed close to the body with straight wrists and relaxed shoulders. No text.
shots.narration: 键盘鼠标放近，手腕保持平直。

shots.scene: 平板放在支架上，抬高屏幕
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tablet raised on a stand instead of lying flat on the bench, a tick; a bent neck crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 记录用平板，用支架把屏幕抬高。

shots.scene: 屏幕侧对窗户，避开反光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a monitor placed side-on to a window to avoid glare reflections. No text.
shots.narration: 屏幕侧对窗户，避开反光。

shots.scene: 眼睛疲劳图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tired eye icon next to a microscope and a monitor. No text.
shots.narration: 久看镜头和屏幕，眼睛会疲劳。

shots.scene: 小研闭眼，用掌心轻捂双眼
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes her eyes and gently covers them with her palms for a moment.
shots.narration: 闭上眼，用掌心捂一会儿。

shots.scene: 小研望向窗外远处一点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks out of the window at a distant tree, relaxing her eyes.
shots.narration: 看看远处，再回来做精细活。

shots.scene: 昏暗的实验台，四个后果图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dim laboratory bench with four icons, a tired eye, an error mark, a worried face and an accident sign. No text.
shots.narration: 照明不足：眼累、出错、紧张、出事故。

shots.scene: 精细操作加台灯局部照明
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an adjustable task lamp lighting a small work area on a bench, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 精细操作，加局部照明。

shots.scene: 灯光直射眼睛的眩光，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare bright lamp shining straight into a person's eyes, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 避开眩光，别让灯直射眼睛。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现灯管闪烁，打电话报修
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a flickering ceiling light and phones the building maintenance office.
shots.narration: 灯坏了、闪了，及时报修。

shots.scene: 一个姿势坐几小时，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure frozen in one posture with a long clock, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 一个姿势不动，最伤身体。

shots.scene: 阿杰起身伸展肩颈和手腕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands up and stretches his neck, shoulders and wrists beside the bench.
shots.narration: 隔一阵起身，伸展肩颈手腕。

shots.scene: 跑步、热身图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of jogging and a warm up stretch before entering the laboratory. No text.
shots.narration: 规律锻炼，上班前活动热身。

shots.scene: 小研向老周说手腕麻
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells the older man that her wrist feels numb, he nods and takes notes.
shots.narration: 酸痛麻木总不好，及时报告就医。

shots.scene: 人、台面、椅子一一对齐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a seated person with elbows level to the bench, feet flat and back supported, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 调好台椅，保持中立姿势。

shots.scene: 物品放近，少伸够少扭身
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: items close in front of a person, overreaching and twisting icons crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 物品放手边，少伸够少扭身。

shots.scene: 坐站换姿、眼睛远眺、灯光充足
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a person switching between sitting and standing, an eye looking far away and a bright lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 换姿、歇眼、照明充足，工间多活动。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一支移液器挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a pipette in one hand and waves goodbye with the other.
shots.narration: 下一课：重复性操作与劳损预防。
